create_rand_augment_transform: create a RandAugment transform from a config string like 'rand-m9-n3-mstd0.5' using rand_augment_transform
build_augment_ops_list: build a list of AugmentOp instances with a given magnitude using rand_augment_ops function
apply_augment_op: apply a single augmentation operation to a PIL image or list of images using AugmentOp
use_rand_augment_class: use the RandAugment class to randomly apply N augmentation operations to an image
apply_shear_transform: apply horizontal or vertical shear to a PIL image using shear_x or shear_y functions
